newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.

The operation -- which was expected -- came an hour earlier than its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period. Analysts said that with federal funds under pressure, trading at 5-5/8 percent, the early operation was to ensure getting sufficient collateral to cover the RPs.
